unit.why: A single narrative: the Besht is called to a childless rich man in Ladmir, perceives that adultery was committed on a bed belonging to an informer, and promises children on the condition that they be born with defects, which comes true.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי ג״כ מהרב דקהלתינו עשיר א׳
stories.end_quote: והיו לו שלשה בנים בעלי חטוטרות
stories.summary_en: Summoned by a childless rich man, the Besht jumps up from a bed on which he perceives adultery was committed, since it was taken from a dead informer's plundered estate, and promises the man sons if he accepts that they will be deformed; three hunchbacked sons are born.

quotes: ואמר על אותו מטה עברו על עון א״א
ואמר כי אין המטה זו משלו
tags.why: Besht knows the bed's sinful history without being told

tags.why: childless man has sons through the Besht's promise
